scope: FreeRTOS with STM32CubeF1 HAL; a fixed GPIO polling task for dht22. Check GPIO input/output, caller-provided microsecond timing hooks, and the millisecond waits actually used.

task_binding.backend: STM32CubeF1 HAL GPIO + board microsecond timing hooks

operations.name: HAL_GPIO_Init
operations.semantics: Configure GPIO direction/mode and pull-up as required by sensor protocol.

operations.name: HAL_GPIO_WritePin
operations.signature: void HAL_GPIO_WritePin(GPIO_TypeDef *GPIOx, uint16_t GPIO_Pin, GPIO_PinState PinState)

operations.name: dht22_delay_us
operations.semantics: Board-supplied microsecond delay; HAL_Delay has millisecond units.

api_contract.preconditions: Caller provides the task-configured and initialized peripheral handle; helper APIs have the RTOS/HAL context documented in the baseline pack.

facts.requirement: Retain the fixed FreeRTOS task's gpio_timing handle/device type and prebound context; the caller supplies the bus instance configured according to task_requirements.
Provide HAL GPIO configuration, reads, and writes, allowing the data pin to switch between open-drain/push-pull output and input with pull-up.
The caller/board provides dht22_delay_us(uint32_t us) for microsecond delays between protocol pulses; HAL_Delay serves only the reference's millisecond waits.
Provide HAL_Delay(uint32_t) in milliseconds for the DHT22 2 ms start-low interval.
